config.name: Coverage Capacity Licenses — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Coverage, Capacity & Licenses
Discovery coverage, license consumption, and group hygiene. Host capacity lives in OOTB Level-3 links.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Are we discovering devices?
  • Unmonitored or minimal gaps?
  • Cloud vs local license mix?
  • Empty groups / dead websites?
Recommended review flow
  1. License strip — Cloud and local
  2. Netscan KPIs + table — Discovery
  3. Unmonitored / netscan trends — Gaps
  4. Group hygiene — Empty groups
  5. OOTB capacity links — Infra utilization
Where to go next
  • Modules → 08
  • Websites → 05
  • Platform Value → 01
Empty / zero: confirm tokens and LogicModules. Healthy zero critical alerts still warrants Warning and dead-resource checks.
